title: Clojure tests fail on macOS: temp paths under /var vs /private/var
description: On macOS, java.io.tmpdir is under /var/folders/..., and /var is a symlink to /private/var. The Clojure suite (clojure -M:test) has 4 failures on the laptop and 0 on Linux (Anvil), at ecd77e9. The tests compare a temp path built from the raw tmpdir with a path the code under test resolved (canonical or git toplevel, which returns /private/var/...). Fix: canonicalize temp paths in the tests (or compare canonical paths), so the suite is green on both platforms. Verify: clojure -M:test green on macOS and Linux; python3 -m unittest discover -s test -p 'test_*.py' still 29/29.
close_reason: temp-dir returns the real path; clojure -M:test 73/530 green on macOS (was 4 failures), python suite OK
